description: Returns a link to the next step on capcenter.com: apply for a mortgage (optionally prefilled with purpose, home value, balance and county), meet a CapCenter real estate agent, or request an insurance quote. Links only; personal details are entered by the person on capcenter.com. Spanish labels with language=es (solicitar, siguiente paso).

action.description: apply (loan application), meet-agent (request a CapCenter REALTOR®) or insurance-quote.

balance.description: apply only, optional prefill (refinance and cash-out): current mortgage balance, whole dollars.

county.description: apply only, optional prefill: rates-page location slug, e.g. henrico-county.

language.description: Response language: en (default) or es (Spanish). Legal disclosures stay in English verbatim, with a Spanish courtesy translation added.

purpose.description: apply only, optional prefill: purchase, refinance or cash-out.

state.description: apply only, optional prefill: two-letter state code.

value.description: apply only, optional prefill: home value (purchase price on a purchase), whole dollars.

name: get_next_step_link
title: Get a CapCenter next-step link
